name: Chase Sapphire Reserve® Credit Card

annual_fee.waiver_conditions: $195 annual fee for each authorized user.

apr.notes: Variable APR shown on Chase product page; confirm current Pricing & Terms.

credit_required.notes: Chase generally targets excellent credit for Sapphire Reserve.

categories.label: Purchases through Chase Travel, including The Edit

rewards.redemption_notes: Points transfer to travel partners; Chase Travel portal redemption rates vary. Purchases that qualify for certain statement credits may not earn points.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 100,000 Ultimate Rewards points after spending $6,000 in the first 3 months; offer varies and may be unavailable to prior holders.

benefits.title: $300 Annual Travel Credit
benefits.description: Up to $300 in statement credits for travel purchases each account anniversary year. Qualifying purchases that receive the credit do not earn points.

benefits.title: The Edit hotel statement credits
benefits.description: Up to $250 statement credit per prepaid The Edit booking (two-night minimum), up to $500 annually. Qualifying purchases do not earn points.

benefits.title: Chase Sapphire Lounge / Priority Pass access
benefits.description: Complimentary access to Chase Sapphire Lounges by The Club and 1,300+ Priority Pass lounges with up to two guests; enrollment and space availability rules apply. Select Air Canada Maple Leaf Lounges/Cafés access with eligible boarding pass.

benefits.title: Global Entry, TSA PreCheck, or NEXUS fee credit
benefits.description: One statement credit of up to $120 every four years for Global Entry, TSA PreCheck, or NEXUS application fee charged to the card.

benefits.title: $300 Sapphire Exclusive Tables dining credit
benefits.description: Up to $150 statement credits Jan–Jun and again Jul–Dec (max $300/year) when dining at restaurants in the Sapphire Exclusive Tables program on OpenTable.

benefits.title: Primary Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Primary CDW reimbursement up to $75,000 for theft/collision on most eligible rentals when you decline the rental company's collision coverage and pay with the card. Restrictions apply; NY residents may have secondary coverage inside the U.S.

benefits.title: Trip Cancellation and Interruption Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $10,000 per covered traveler / $20,000 per trip for prepaid non-refundable travel expenses for covered reasons.

benefits.title: Baggage Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Reimburses up to $100/day for up to 5 days for essentials when baggage is delayed over 6 hours.

benefits.title: Lost Luggage Reimbursement
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $3,000 per covered traveler for lost, damaged, or stolen checked/carry-on baggage on a covered trip.

lounge_access.program: Chase Sapphire Lounge by The Club + Priority Pass Select
lounge_access.notes: Primary cardholder plus up to two guests; Priority Pass enrollment required for that network.

travel_perks.hotel_status: IHG One Rewards Platinum Elite through 2027-12-31 (confirm current Chase terms)

notes: Premium Sapphire product; annual fee, credits, and lounge policies change — verify Pricing & Terms and Guide to Benefits before publishing comparisons.
